description: A dated occurrence at a place, hosted by an organization. Maps to schema.org MusicEvent. Ticket classes, performances and the program are separate records that reference the event.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name used to display times.

venue.description: DID of the venue organization, when it is a distinct OMP organization.

ageRestriction.description: Free text such as 'All ages' or '21+'.

taxNote.description: Organizer-set statement of any sales or amusement tax included in the all-in price.

refundPolicy.description: Machine-readable refund policy. Defaults are the fan-expected norm: full refund of the all-in price on cancellation.

onCancellation.description: What a buyer gets if the event is cancelled.

onPostponement.description: honor: ticket is valid for the new date; honorOrFull: buyer may choose.

feeDisclosure.description: What the all-in price includes. The platform fee is always disclosed; for OMP v1 it is zero.

platformFeeCents.description: Per-ticket platform fee included in the all-in price. 0 in OMP v1.

organizerFeeCents.description: Optional per-ticket fee the organizer sets and keeps, disclosed as its own line.

processorNote.description: Statement that card processing is paid by the organizer from the all-in price.
